verified_report_totals.basis: June-August calendar months; not calendar Q3

definition: Police Scotland operational suspected deaths, not registered confirmed drug-related deaths. Databelt records from January 2025 supersede manual reporting and may be revised retrospectively.
legacy_difference: The legacy quarterly series retains originally suspected cases and applies a ten-day adjustment to approximate registration timing. Equivalence with the Databelt time basis/retention rules has not been established.
revision_policy: Latest RADAR update supersedes prior figures; provisional cases may be added after COPFS receipt or further investigation. No quantitative overlap revision comparison was possible.
dashboard_inspection: Rendered live dashboard confirmed update 27 October 2026, weekly display, police-division June-August/March-May/December-February periods and national/area download controls. Search cache incorrectly showed July, so live inspection was used.
download_blocker: Automatic approval review could not complete due to a usage limit. The acquisition command was not executed and was not retried.
compatibility_decision: Do not append these reporting-window totals to frozen calendar quarters. Do not calculate independent evaluation errors or coverage without exact compatible outcomes. No model reselection or current forecasts.
